Name: safety_representation_control
Title: Representation Engineering for LLM Safety Alignment
Experiment: Modify the model to add a safety projection layer that maps hidden states to a safety subspace. Train with contrastive loss to separate safe versus unsafe representations. Measure safety-utility tradeoff.

Name: reward_model_ensemble
Title: Ensemble Reward Modeling for Robust RLHF
Experiment: Train multiple reward models with different initializations. Use ensemble disagreement as uncertainty signal to detect reward hacking. Compare with single reward model baseline on safety benchmarks.

Name: adversarial_red_teaming
Title: Multi-Agent Red Teaming for Automated Safety Evaluation
Experiment: Deploy multiple LLM agents as adversarial testers. Each agent specializes in different attack strategies (semantic manipulation, syntactic obfuscation, multi-turn escalation). Evaluate model robustness.
